svg.aria-label: KeyLinker packet layout and the scramble applied on the wire
KeyLinker packet layout: opcode, length, serial, nonce, payload, CRC-8, then scrambled

g.text: Six fields, one checksum, one scramble.
encrypt(): XOR with two fixed keystreams
CRC-8 is reflected, polynomial 0xEB, init 0x00, no final XOR. The checksum byte passes through the scramble unchanged.
It is scrambling, not cryptography: no key exchange, no authentication, so packets can be built offline.
